entities.summary: Modupe Olusola is a Nigerian business executive. She was the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of the Nigeria-based Hospitality company, Transcorp Hotels plc, subsidiary of the Nigerian conglomerate, Transnational Corporation of Nigeria. from March 2020 to December 2024.
